channel.title: The Drill Down: Seattle Seahawks
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 12: Seahawks at 49ers
item.description: Sun 11/29 · 4:25 PM ET | Line: SF -3 · O/U 46.5 | Model SF 81% vs. market 57% | Seattle must keep everything in front against a San Francisco offense that turns red-zone trips into touchdowns 68% of the time, while the Seahawks defense allows explosive plays on just 6.9% of snaps. Jaxon Smith-Njigba draws Seattle's biggest share of targets, and he runs into a San Francisco pass defense ranked 3rd, so Sam Darnold must keep finding him. Our model gives San Francisco 81% against a market price of 57%, driven mostly by the starting quarterback and the passing matchup.

item.title: Week 10: Seahawks at Raiders
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 4:05 PM ET | Line: SEA -6.5 · O/U 40.5 | Model LV 48% vs. market 28% | The game may turn on whether Las Vegas can finish drives, since the Raiders convert only 58% of red-zone trips against a Seattle defense that allows 67%, a bottom-tier mark. Jaxon Smith-Njigba is the player to watch, drawing 35% of Seattle's targets and running into a Las Vegas pass defense ranked 32nd. Our model puts Seattle at 52%, far below the market's 72%, with the passing matchup providing most of the lift toward the Seahawks.
